```{r setup}
# ---- Setup ----
# Run this chunk first. It loads packages, sets the project folder, and creates the figure folder.

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(openair)
library(sf)
library(lubridate)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(ggpubr)
library(viridis)

setwd("/Users/richardbeaumont/R_projects/1st_Paper") # change this to your preferred wd 

fig_dir <- "figures"
dir.create(fig_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

who_pm25 <- 5 # WHO 2021 annual PM2.5 guideline concentration (µg m-5)
```


```{r load_saved_core_objects}
# ---- Load saved core analysis datasets ----
# This project uses saved local analysis datasets instead of re-querying ULC.
# Keep analysis_core_objects.RData in the project folder and back it up to the Sheffield X Drive.

load("analysis_core_objects.RData")

required_objects <- c(
  "In_Out_24",
  "In_Out_SchHrs",
  "In_Out_OutSchHrs",
  "df_school_chars"
)

missing_objects <- required_objects[
  !vapply(required_objects, exists, logical(1), inherits = TRUE)
]

if (length(missing_objects) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required object(s): ",
    paste(missing_objects, collapse = ", "),
    ". Check that analysis_core_objects.RData is in the working directory and contains the core datasets."
  )
}

# ---- Choose active air-quality dataset ----
# Change only this line to rerun figures with a different dataset:
# Options: "all_time", "school_hours", "outside_school_hours"

active_dataset_name <- "school_hours"

air_quality_datasets <- list(
  all_time = In_Out_24,
  school_hours = In_Out_SchHrs,
  outside_school_hours = In_Out_OutSchHrs
)

analysis_labels <- c(
  all_time = "All time",
  school_hours = "School hours",
  outside_school_hours = "Term time outside school hours"
)

analysis_data <- air_quality_datasets[[active_dataset_name]]
analysis_label <- analysis_labels[[active_dataset_name]]

if (is.null(analysis_data)) {
  stop("Invalid active_dataset_name: ", active_dataset_name)
}

if (is.null(analysis_label)) {
  stop("No label found for active_dataset_name: ", active_dataset_name)
}

# ---- Remove HEPA-monitoring schools from main analysis dataset ----
# This affects all active datasets: all_time, school_hours, and outside_school_hours.
# Figure 9 should still use the original dataset because it compares HEPA vs non-HEPA.

hepa_school_ids <- df_school_chars %>%
  filter(MonitoringType == 2) %>%
  distinct(SchoolId_short)

analysis_data <- analysis_data %>%
  anti_join(hepa_school_ids, by = "SchoolId_short")

message("Active dataset: ", analysis_label)
message("HEPA-monitoring schools removed from main analysis: ", nrow(hepa_school_ids))

# Quick size check
print(
  sort(
    sapply(required_objects, function(x) object.size(get(x))),
    decreasing = TRUE
  ),
  units = "auto"
)
```

```{r create_outside_school_hours_dataset_once, eval=FALSE}
# ---- One-off maintenance chunk ----
# Run only if In_Out_OutSchHrs needs to be recreated.
# Creates term-time outside-school-hours data from In_Out_24.
# It uses In_Out_SchHrs only to identify term-time school dates.
# It does not apply the CO2 occupancy exclusion.

school_start <- 9
school_end   <- 16

term_school_dates <- In_Out_SchHrs %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(DateTime)) %>%
  distinct(SchoolId_short, date)

In_Out_OutSchHrs <- In_Out_24 %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(DateTime),
    hour = lubridate::hour(DateTime)
  ) %>%
  semi_join(term_school_dates, by = c("SchoolId_short", "date")) %>%
  filter(hour < school_start | hour >= school_end) %>%
  select(-date, -hour)

rm(term_school_dates)
gc()
```


```{r update_core_objects_once, eval=FALSE}
# ---- One-off maintenance chunk ----
# Run only after recreating and checking In_Out_OutSchHrs.
# This overwrites analysis_core_objects.RData.

save(
  In_Out_24,
  In_Out_SchHrs,
  In_Out_OutSchHrs,
  df_school_chars,
  file = "analysis_core_objects.RData",
  compress = "gzip"
)
```



```{r figure_1_map}
# Figure 1: Map of identified SAMHE sites and corresponding DEFRA/AURN sites.

fig1_pairs <- In_Out_24 %>%
  distinct(SchoolId_short, site, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(
    SchoolId_short,
    SAMHE_lon = SchoolLongitude,
    SAMHE_lat = SchoolLatitude,
    AURN_site = site,
    AURN_lon  = longitude,
    AURN_lat  = latitude,
    distance_km = km_distance_to_AURN
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(SAMHE_lat),
    !is.na(SAMHE_lon),
    !is.na(AURN_lat),
    !is.na(AURN_lon),
    !is.na(distance_km)
  )

fig1_dist_stats <- fig1_pairs %>%
  summarise(
    n_schools = n_distinct(SchoolId_short),
    mean_km   = mean(distance_km, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_km = median(distance_km, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_km    = min(distance_km, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_km    = max(distance_km, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups   = "drop"
  )

fig1_stats_label <- paste0(
  "n = ", fig1_dist_stats$n_schools, "\n",
  "Mean = ", round(fig1_dist_stats$mean_km, 1), " km\n",
  "Median = ", round(fig1_dist_stats$median_km, 1), " km\n",
  "Range = ", round(fig1_dist_stats$min_km, 1), "–",
  round(fig1_dist_stats$max_km, 0), " km"
)

samhe_sf <- st_as_sf(
  fig1_pairs,
  coords = c("SAMHE_lon", "SAMHE_lat"),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
)

aurn_sf <- st_as_sf(
  fig1_pairs,
  coords = c("AURN_lon", "AURN_lat"),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
)

lines_sf <- st_as_sf(
  fig1_pairs %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      geometry = st_sfc(
        st_linestring(
          matrix(
            c(SAMHE_lon, SAMHE_lat, AURN_lon, AURN_lat),
            ncol = 2,
            byrow = TRUE
          )
        ),
        crs = 4326
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup(),
  crs = 4326
)

uk <- rnaturalearth::ne_states(
  country = "United Kingdom",
  returnclass = "sf"
)

fig1_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = uk,
    fill = "grey95",
    colour = "grey50",
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = lines_sf,
    colour = "grey65",
    linewidth = 0.25,
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = aurn_sf,
    aes(shape = "AURN sites"),
    fill = "white",
    colour = "black",
    size = 0.8,
    stroke = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = samhe_sf,
    colour = "black",
    shape = 16,
    size = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = samhe_sf,
    aes(colour = distance_km),
    shape = 16,
    size = 0.6,
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(-8.5, 2.5),
    ylim = c(49.5, 60.9),
    clip = "off"
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(
    trans = "log10",
    option = "viridis",
    breaks = c(1, 10, 100),
    labels = c("1", "10", "100 km"),
    name = paste0(
      "SAMHE to nearest AURN\n",
      fig1_stats_label
    )
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c("AURN sites" = 21)
  ) +
  guides(
    colour = guide_colourbar(
      order = 1,
      title.position = "top",
      title.theme = element_text(size = 7),
      label.theme = element_text(size = 7),
      barheight = unit(2.5, "cm"),
      barwidth = unit(0.35, "cm")
    ),
    shape = guide_legend(
      order = 2,
      override.aes = list(
        fill = "white",
        colour = "black",
        size = 2
      )
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
theme(
  panel.grid = element_blank(),
  axis.text = element_text(size = 7),
  axis.title = element_blank(),
  legend.position = "right",
  legend.title = element_text(size = 7),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
  legend.box = "vertical",
  legend.spacing.y = unit(0.15, "cm"),
  plot.margin = margin(5.5, 20, 5.5, 5.5)
)

fig1_map

ggsave(
  file.path(fig_dir, "Figure_1_SAMHE_AURN_pairing_map.png"),
  plot = fig1_map,
  width = 6,
  height = 4,
  dpi = 600
)
```


```{r figure_2_daily_timeseries}
# Figure 2 supplementary: daily mean indoor and outdoor PM2.5 time series
# Uses active dataset selected in load_saved_core_objects chunk.

daily_pm25 <- In_Out_24 %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(DateTime)) %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(
    Indoor_mean   = mean(pm02, na.rm = TRUE),
    Indoor_q25    = quantile(pm02, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Indoor_q75    = quantile(pm02, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    Outdoor_mean  = mean(pm2.5, 0.00, na.rm = TRUE),
    Outdoor_q25   = quantile(pm2.5, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Outdoor_q75   = quantile(pm2.5, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = -date,
    names_to = c("site", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(Indoor|Outdoor)_(mean|q25|q75)"
  )

daily_r2_spearman <- cor(
  daily_pm25$mean[daily_pm25$site == "Indoor"],
  daily_pm25$mean[daily_pm25$site == "Outdoor"],
  method = "spearman",
  use = "complete.obs"
)^2

fig2_annual_for_who <- In_Out_24 %>%
  mutate(Year = as.integer(format(DateTime, "%Y"))) %>%
  filter(Year %in% 2023:2025) %>%
  group_by(SchoolId_short) %>%
  summarise(
    indoor_pm25  = mean(pm02, na.rm = TRUE),
    outdoor_pm25 = mean(pm2.5, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(indoor_pm25), is.finite(outdoor_pm25))

fig2_who_summary <- fig2_annual_for_who %>%
  summarise(
    n_schools = n_distinct(SchoolId_short),
    indoor_above_who = sum(indoor_pm25 > who_pm25, na.rm = TRUE),
    indoor_pct_above_who = round(100 * indoor_above_who / n_schools, 1),
    outdoor_above_who = sum(outdoor_pm25 > who_pm25, na.rm = TRUE),
    outdoor_pct_above_who = round(100 * outdoor_above_who / n_schools, 1),
    both_above_who = sum(indoor_pm25 > who_pm25 & outdoor_pm25 > who_pm25, na.rm = TRUE),
    both_pct_above_who = round(100 * both_above_who / n_schools, 1)
  )

fig2_who_summary

ggplot(daily_pm25, aes(x = date, y = mean, colour = site, fill = site)) +
  #geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q25, ymax = q75), alpha = 0.15, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = who_pm25, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey30") +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(Outdoor = "#E57200", Indoor = "#7A1FA2"),
    labels = c(Outdoor = "Outdoor (DEFRA)", Indoor = "Indoor (SAMHE)")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(Outdoor = "#E57200", Indoor = "#7A1FA2"),
    labels = c(Outdoor = "Outdoor (AURN)", Indoor = "Indoor (SAMHE)")
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = min(daily_pm25$date),
    y = max(daily_pm25$mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    label = paste0("R² = ", round(daily_r2_spearman, 2), ", p < 0.001"),
    hjust = 0
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Daily mean indoor and outdoor PM2.5 (", analysis_label, ")"),
    x = "Date",
    y = expression("Daily mean PM"[2.5]),
    colour = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    caption = expression("Dashed line indicates the WHO annual PM"[2.5]~"guideline of 5 µg m"^-3*".")
  ) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "3 months", date_labels = "%b '%y") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    #aspect.ratio = 0.25,
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0)
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(fig_dir, paste0("Figure_2_daily_indoor_outdoor_PM25_timeseries_", active_dataset_name, ".png")),
  width = 24,
  height = 3,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r figure_3_annual_io}
# Figure 3: annual school-year I/O ratio vs outdoor PM2.5.
# Uses active dataset selected by active_dataset_name.

fig3_io_annual <- analysis_data %>%
  mutate(Year = as.integer(format(DateTime, "%Y"))) %>%
  filter(Year %in% 2023:2025) %>%
  group_by(SchoolId_short, Year) %>%
  summarise(
    indoor_pm25  = mean(pm02, na.rm = TRUE),
    outdoor_pm25 = mean(pm2.5, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(indoor_pm25),
    is.finite(outdoor_pm25),
    outdoor_pm25 > 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    io_ratio = indoor_pm25 / outdoor_pm25,
    Year = factor(Year)
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(io_ratio), io_ratio > 0)

fig3_cor <- cor.test(
  fig3_io_annual$outdoor_pm25,
  fig3_io_annual$io_ratio,
  method = "pearson"
)

fig3_lm <- lm(io_ratio ~ outdoor_pm25, data = fig3_io_annual)

fig3_stats_label <- paste0(
  "n = ", nrow(fig3_io_annual),
  "\nPearson r = ", round(unname(fig3_cor$estimate), 2),
  "\np = ", format.pval(fig3_cor$p.value, digits = 2, eps = 0.001),
  "\nR² = ", round(summary(fig3_lm)$r.squared, 2)
)

ggplot(fig3_io_annual, aes(x = outdoor_pm25, y = io_ratio, colour = Year)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "lm", se = TRUE, colour = "black") +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf,
    y = Inf,
    label = fig3_stats_label,
    hjust = 1.05,
    vjust = 1.2,
    size = 5
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 2)) +
  labs(
    x = "Annual mean outdoor PM2.5 (µg m-3)",
    y = "Annual mean I/O ratio",
    colour = "Year",
    title = paste0(
      "Annual mean I/O ratio vs outdoor PM2.5 (2023–2025, ",
      analysis_label,
      ")"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

ggsave(
  file.path(
    fig_dir,
    paste0(
      "Figure_3_annual_school_year_IO_ratio_vs_outdoor_PM25_",
      active_dataset_name,
      ".png"
    )
  ),
  width = 6,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r figure_3_seasonal_io}
# Figure 3: Seasonal I/O ratio vs outdoor PM2.5
# RQ1 / Objective 1: infiltration behaviour and seasonal variability
# Uses active dataset selected by active_dataset_name.

fig3_seasonal_io <- analysis_data %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.POSIXct(DateTime),
    Year = as.integer(format(date, "%Y"))
  ) %>%
  filter(Year %in% 2023:2025) %>%
  openair::cutData(type = "season") %>%
  mutate(
    season = as.character(season),
    season = case_when(
      grepl("win", season, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Winter",
      grepl("spr", season, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Spring",
      grepl("sum", season, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Summer",
      grepl("aut", season, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Autumn",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(SchoolId_short, Year, season) %>%
  summarise(
    indoor   = mean(pm02, na.rm = TRUE),
    outdoor  = mean(pm2.5, na.rm = TRUE),
    IO_ratio = indoor / outdoor,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(indoor),
    is.finite(outdoor),
    is.finite(IO_ratio),
    outdoor > 0,
    IO_ratio > 0,
    !is.na(season)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Year = factor(Year),
    season = factor(season, levels = c("Winter", "Spring", "Summer", "Autumn"))
  )

fig3_seasonal_stats <- fig3_seasonal_io %>%
  group_by(season) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    r = cor(outdoor, IO_ratio, use = "complete.obs"),
    r2 = summary(lm(IO_ratio ~ outdoor))$r.squared,
    label = paste0(
      "n = ", n,
      "\nr = ", round(r, 2),
      "\nR² = ", round(r2, 2)
    ),
    x = Inf,
    y = Inf,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(fig3_seasonal_io, aes(x = outdoor, y = IO_ratio, colour = Year)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 0.9) +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "lm", se = FALSE, colour = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~season) +
  geom_text(
    data = fig3_seasonal_stats,
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 1.1,
    vjust = 1.1,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 20), ylim = c(0, 2)) +
  labs(
    x = expression("Seasonal mean outdoor PM"[2.5]~"(µg m"^-3*")"),
    y = "Seasonal mean I/O ratio",
    colour = "Year",
    title = paste0(
      "Seasonal I/O ratio vs outdoor PM2.5 (",
      analysis_label,
      ", 2023–2025)"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

ggsave(
  file.path(
    fig_dir,
    paste0("Figure_3_seasonal_IO_ratio_vs_outdoor_PM25_", active_dataset_name, ".png")
  ),
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```


```{r figure_4_ventilation_type}
# Figure 4: Indoor PM2.5 vs ventilation type.
# Uses active dataset selected by active_dataset_name.

fig4_ventilation <- analysis_data %>%
  group_by(SchoolId_short) %>%
  summarise(
    indoor_pm25 = mean(pm02, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    df_school_chars %>%
      select(SchoolId_short, BuildingEnvironment) %>%
      distinct(),
    by = "SchoolId_short"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !BuildingEnvironment %in% c(
      "Mixed-mode with Natural Ventilation",
      "Unconditioned"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(BuildingEnvironment), is.finite(indoor_pm25))

fig4_anova <- aov(indoor_pm25 ~ BuildingEnvironment, data = fig4_ventilation)
fig4_anova_tab <- summary(fig4_anova)[[1]]
fig4_f <- round(fig4_anova_tab$`F value`[1], 2)
fig4_p <- signif(fig4_anova_tab$`Pr(>F)`[1], 2)

fig4_n <- fig4_ventilation %>%
  count(BuildingEnvironment)

fig4_ymax <- max(fig4_ventilation$indoor_pm25, na.rm = TRUE)

fig4_who_summary <- fig4_ventilation %>%
  group_by(BuildingEnvironment) %>%
  summarise(
    n_schools = n(),
    n_above_who = sum(indoor_pm25 > who_pm25, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_above_who = round(100 * n_above_who / n_schools, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

fig4_who_summary

fig4_plot <- ggplot(fig4_ventilation, aes(x = BuildingEnvironment, y = indoor_pm25)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = who_pm25, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey30") +
  geom_text(
    data = fig4_n,
    aes(x = BuildingEnvironment, y = fig4_ymax * 1.03, label = paste0("n=", n)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 1,
    y = fig4_ymax * 1.12,
    hjust = 0,
    label = paste0("ANOVA: F = ", fig4_f, ", p = ", fig4_p),
    size = 4
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Ventilation type",
    y = expression("Annual mean indoor PM"[2.5]~"(µg/m"^3*")"),
    title = paste0("Indoor PM2.5 by ventilation type (", analysis_label, ")"),
    caption = expression("Dashed line indicates the WHO annual PM"[2.5]~"guideline of 5 µg m"^-3*".")
    ) +
  
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0)
  )

fig4_plot

summary(fig4_anova)

ggsave(
  file.path(
    fig_dir,
    paste0("Figure_4_indoor_PM25_by_ventilation_type_", active_dataset_name, ".png")
  ),
  plot = fig4_plot,

)
```

```{r figure_4_ventilation_group}
# Figure 4: Indoor PM2.5 by ventilation group.
# Mechanical = Air Conditioning + Heating and Mechanical Ventilation.
# Natural = Heating and Natural Ventilation.
# Sparse groups are excluded.

fig4_vent_group <- analysis_data %>%
  group_by(SchoolId_short) %>%
  summarise(
    indoor_pm25 = mean(pm02, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    df_school_chars %>%
      select(SchoolId_short, BuildingEnvironment) %>%
      distinct(),
    by = "SchoolId_short"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(BuildingEnvironment), is.finite(indoor_pm25)) %>%
  mutate(
    Vent_group = case_when(
      BuildingEnvironment %in% c(
        "Air Conditioning",
        "Heating and Mechanical Ventilation"
      ) ~ "Mechanical",
      BuildingEnvironment == "Heating and Natural Ventilation" ~ "Natural",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Vent_group)) %>%
  mutate(
    Vent_group = factor(Vent_group, levels = c("Natural", "Mechanical"))
  )

fig4_vent_ttest <- t.test(indoor_pm25 ~ Vent_group, data = fig4_vent_group)
fig4_vent_p <- signif(fig4_vent_ttest$p.value, 2)

fig4_vent_n <- fig4_vent_group %>%
  count(Vent_group)

fig4_vent_ymax <- max(fig4_vent_group$indoor_pm25, na.rm = TRUE)

fig4_vent_who_summary <- fig4_vent_group %>%
  group_by(Vent_group) %>%
  summarise(
    n_schools = n(),
    n_above_who = sum(indoor_pm25 > who_pm25, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_above_who = round(100 * n_above_who / n_schools, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

fig4_vent_who_summary

fig4_vent_group_plot <- ggplot(fig4_vent_group, aes(x = Vent_group, y = indoor_pm25)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = who_pm25, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey30") +
  geom_text(
    data = fig4_vent_n,
    aes(x = Vent_group, y = fig4_vent_ymax * 1.03, label = paste0("n=", n)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 1,
    y = fig4_vent_ymax * 1.12,
    hjust = 0,
    label = paste0("t-test p = ", fig4_vent_p),
    size = 4
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Ventilation group",
    y = expression("Annual mean indoor PM"[2.5]~"(µg/m"^3*")"),
    title = paste0("Indoor PM2.5 by ventilation group (", analysis_label, ")"),
    caption = expression("Dashed line indicates the WHO annual PM"[2.5]~"guideline of 5 µg m"^-3*".")
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0)
  )

fig4_vent_group_plot

# fig4_vent_ttest
```

```{r figure_8_co2_io}
# Figure 8: CO2 vs I/O PM2.5 ratio.
# Uses active dataset selected by active_dataset_name.
# CO2 is interpreted most directly as an occupancy/ventilation proxy in the school-hours subset.

fig8_co2_io <- analysis_data %>%
  mutate(Year = as.integer(format(DateTime, "%Y"))) %>%
  filter(Year %in% 2023:2025) %>%
  group_by(SchoolId_short, Year) %>%
  summarise(
    indoor_pm25  = mean(pm02, na.rm = TRUE),
    outdoor_pm25 = mean(pm2.5, na.rm = TRUE),
    co2          = mean(rco2, na.rm = TRUE),
    io_ratio     = indoor_pm25 / outdoor_pm25,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(io_ratio),
    is.finite(co2),
    outdoor_pm25 > 1,
    io_ratio < 5
  )

fig8_stats <- fig8_co2_io %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    spearman_rho = round(cor(co2, io_ratio, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"), 2),
    p_value = signif(cor.test(co2, io_ratio, method = "spearman")$p.value, 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

fig8_stats

fig8_stats_label <- paste0(
  paste0(
    fig8_stats$Year,
    ": n = ", fig8_stats$n,
    ", Spearman r = ", fig8_stats$spearman_rho,
    ", p = ", fig8_stats$p_value
  ),
  collapse = "\n"
)

fig8_plot <- ggplot(fig8_co2_io, aes(x = co2, y = io_ratio, colour = factor(Year))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = min(fig8_co2_io$co2, na.rm = TRUE),
    y = max(fig8_co2_io$io_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 1,
    label = fig8_stats_label,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  labs(
    x = expression("Mean CO"[2]~"(ppm)"),
    y = expression("Indoor / outdoor PM"[2.5]~"ratio"),
    colour = "Year",
    title = paste0("CO2 vs PM2.5 I/O ratio (", analysis_label, ")"),
    caption = "CO2 is interpreted most directly as an occupancy/ventilation proxy in the school-hours subset."
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0))

fig8_plot

ggsave(
  file.path(
    fig_dir,
    paste0("Figure_8_CO2_vs_IO_ratio_", active_dataset_name, ".png")
  ),
  plot = fig8_plot,
  width = 7,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r figure_9_hepa}
# Figure 9: Annual mean I/O PM2.5 ratio by HEPA status.

fig9_hepa <- In_Out_SchHrs %>%
  group_by(SchoolId_short) %>%
  summarise(
    indoor_pm25  = mean(pm02, na.rm = TRUE),
    outdoor_pm25 = mean(pm2.5, na.rm = TRUE),
    io_ratio     = indoor_pm25 / outdoor_pm25,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    df_school_chars %>%
      select(SchoolId_short, MonitoringType) %>%
      distinct(),
    by = "SchoolId_short"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(MonitoringType), is.finite(io_ratio)) %>%
  mutate(
    HEPA = case_when(
      MonitoringType == 1 ~ "No HEPA",
      MonitoringType == 2 ~ "HEPA",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(HEPA))

fig9_ttest <- t.test(io_ratio ~ HEPA, data = fig9_hepa)
fig9_p <- signif(fig9_ttest$p.value, 2)

fig9_summary <- fig9_hepa %>%
  group_by(HEPA) %>%
  summarise(
    n_schools = n(),
    mean_io = mean(io_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_io = median(io_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_io = sd(io_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_io_below_1 = 100 * mean(io_ratio < 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

fig9_summary

hepa_mean <- fig9_summary$mean_io[fig9_summary$HEPA == "HEPA"]
nohepa_mean <- fig9_summary$mean_io[fig9_summary$HEPA == "No HEPA"]

fig9_pct_reduction <- 100 * (nohepa_mean - hepa_mean) / nohepa_mean

cat(
  "HEPA mean I/O =", round(hepa_mean, 2), "\n",
  "No HEPA mean I/O =", round(nohepa_mean, 2), "\n",
  "Percentage reduction in mean I/O =", round(fig9_pct_reduction, 1), "%\n",
  "t-test p =", fig9_p, "\n"
)

fig9_n <- fig9_hepa %>%
  count(HEPA)

fig9_ymax <- max(fig9_hepa$io_ratio, na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot(fig9_hepa, aes(x = HEPA, y = io_ratio)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_text(
    data = fig9_n,
    aes(x = HEPA, y = fig9_ymax * 1.03, label = paste0("n=", n)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 1,
    y = fig9_ymax * 1.12,
    hjust = 0,
    label = paste0(
      "t-test p = ", fig9_p,
      "\nMean I/O reduction = ", round(fig9_pct_reduction, 1), "%"
    ),
    size = 4
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Annual mean indoor / outdoor PM2.5 ratio"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

ggsave(
  file.path(fig_dir, "Figure_9_IO_ratio_by_HEPA_status.png"),
  width = 6,
  height = 4,
  dpi = 300
)

fig9_ttest
```

```{r}
# Figure 2: daily mean indoor and outdoor PM2.5 time series.
# Uses the full In_Out_24 dataset.
# Poster version with compact in-plot legend and larger date labels.

daily_pm25 <- In_Out_24 %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(DateTime)) %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(
    Indoor_mean  = mean(pm02, na.rm = TRUE),
    Outdoor_mean = mean(pm2.5, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Indoor_mean, Outdoor_mean),
    names_to = "site",
    values_to = "mean"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    site = recode(
      site,
      Indoor_mean = "Indoor (SAMHE)",
      Outdoor_mean = "Outdoor (AURN)"
    )
  )

fig2_daily_plot <- ggplot(
  daily_pm25,
  aes(x = date, y = mean)
) +
  geom_line(
    aes(colour = site),
    linewidth = 0.65
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    aes(yintercept = who_pm25, linetype = "WHO annual guideline"),
    colour = "grey30",
    linewidth = 0.6,
    show.legend = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Indoor (SAMHE)" = "#7A1FA2",
      "Outdoor (AURN)" = "#E57200"
    ),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c("WHO annual guideline" = "dashed"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  guides(
    colour = guide_legend(
      order = 1,
      nrow = 1,
      override.aes = list(linewidth = 0.8)
    ),
    linetype = guide_legend(
      order = 2,
      nrow = 1,
      override.aes = list(
        colour = "grey30",
        linewidth = 0.8
      )
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_date(
    limits = range(daily_pm25$date, na.rm = TRUE),
    date_breaks = "3 months",
    date_labels = "%b '%y",
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = expression("Daily mean indoor and outdoor PM"[2.5]),
    x = "Date",
    y = expression("Daily mean PM"[2.5])
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 12,
      hjust = 0.5,
      margin = margin(b = 8)
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 9),

    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.key.width = unit(1.1, "cm"),
    legend.spacing.x = unit(0.25, "cm"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(3, 3, 3, 3)
  )
```

```{r}
# Poster version: no ANOVA label, horizontal category labels, purple boxplots.

fig4_ventilation <- analysis_data %>%
  group_by(SchoolId_short) %>%
  summarise(
    indoor_pm25 = mean(pm02, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    df_school_chars %>%
      select(SchoolId_short, BuildingEnvironment) %>%
      distinct(),
    by = "SchoolId_short"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !BuildingEnvironment %in% c(
      "Mixed-mode with Natural Ventilation",
      "Unconditioned"
    ),
    !is.na(BuildingEnvironment),
    is.finite(indoor_pm25)
  )

fig4_n <- fig4_ventilation %>%
  count(BuildingEnvironment)

fig4_ymax <- max(fig4_ventilation$indoor_pm25, na.rm = TRUE)

fig4_who_summary <- fig4_ventilation %>%
  group_by(BuildingEnvironment) %>%
  summarise(
    n_schools = n(),
    n_above_who = sum(indoor_pm25 > who_pm25, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_above_who = round(100 * n_above_who / n_schools, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

fig4_who_summary

fig4_plot <- ggplot(
  fig4_ventilation,
  aes(x = BuildingEnvironment, y = indoor_pm25)
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    fill = "#7A1FA2",
    colour = "black",
    alpha = 0.35,
    width = 0.65
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = who_pm25,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey30",
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = fig4_n,
    aes(
      x = BuildingEnvironment,
      y = fig4_ymax * 1.03,
      label = paste0("n=", n)
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 4
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Ventilation type",
    y = expression("Annual mean indoor PM"[2.5]~"(µg/m"^3*")"),
    title = expression("Indoor PM"[2.5]~"by ventilation type")
    
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 18,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5,
      margin = margin(b = 10)
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 11,
      angle = 0,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    plot.caption = element_text(
      size = 10,
      hjust = 0
    ),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8)
  )

fig4_plot

ggsave(
  file.path(
    fig_dir,
    paste0(
      "Figure_4_indoor_PM25_by_ventilation_type_",
      active_dataset_name,
      "_poster.png"
    )
  ),
  plot = fig4_plot,
  width = 300,
  height = 190,
  units = "mm",
  dpi = 300
)
```
